svg.title: About me
svg.desc: I am Nugraha Labib Mujaddid (Nugi), an AI founder, agentic engineer and entrepreneur. I bridge advanced technology with business innovation, corporate governance, legal compliance and the procurement rules that decide whether a system can really be deployed. As Founder and Lead AI Engineer of Spead AI, incubated at Caliana Indonesia and validated through the Google for Startups: AI Solution Lab Program 2025, I design multi-agent systems for government bodies, state-owned enterprises and regulated industries, hosted on private cloud or on premise. Our contextual RAG engine cut reporting turnaround by 87%. I also build AgentBuff, AI employees for small businesses, and lead the internal platforms of the EPCC Division at WIKA. My work is anchored in research and risk discipline: a Master of Management in New Ventures Innovation at Prasetiya Mulya, strategy work for the President Director of Caliana, and two years of multi-billion rupiah contracts and claims at PT Waskita Karya. Beyond software I run a 100+ room property business, two F&B brands and a TikTok channel with 130K+ followers. 8+ Years running businesses; 8 Ventures since 2018; 3+ Years building AI systems; 4+ Years in software and cloud; 2 Years at a BUMN contractor; 5+ Years creating tech content. Tools: MCP, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, n8n, Pinecone, pgvector, Python, TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, React, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Docker, Google Cloud, Playwright, Figma, CapCut.
